summary: NM type's specimen page for Movement, a free variable font (wght and a custom SPAC axis) drawn by tracking the movements of dancer Andile Vellem for Design Indaba, after Laban's movement theory. A dark cover, then one white column: five editable tester rows each set in one of the four extremes or the variable mode, a credits sidebar beside the story, the performance film and looping dancer clips, a poster for sale, a style-tabbed glyph grid, a language list and award badges.

instances.look: Sticky dark bar: 'NM type' logo (collapses to two short bars when scrolled), Fonts · Custom · Articles centred with the active one underlined, '→ Download Movement' at the right; it overlaps the stitched crops repeatedly
A short charcoal band with 'MOVEMENT' in white heavy caps (Direct Black) across the width, 'Variable font' bottom-left and '→ Trial fonts' bottom-right in small white text
instances.ux: Trial link; the nav's Download link is the main CTA
instances.learn: A shared foundry cover template (name as SVG, two corner notes) keeps every specimen consistent while the name itself shows the font

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed 1440×392 below the 80px nav; name SVG spans ~x 130–1310 at y≈150–260; notes at y≈360 left and right of the same margins
reconstruction.typography: Name in Movement Direct Black (wght 900, SPAC 100) caps as SVG, ~150px cap height; notes ~13px nmtype sans, 'Variable font' bold
reconstruction.behaviour: none (nav logo animates to bars on scroll)

instances.look: Five editable black samples on white, each under a thin control line (style dropdown at left, 'Size' hairline slider with value): BODY IN MOTION (Direct Black, 92), DESIGN INDABA (Direct Thin, 240), THE PERFORMER ANDILE VELLEM (Indirect Black, 100), a Rudolf Laban sentence (Indirect Thin, 50), and DANCE! (Variable, 232) with extra Weight and Space sliders
instances.ux: Pick one of the four extremes or 'Variable' per row (Variable reveals Weight 100–900 and Space 100–120 sliders), drag size, type over the text
instances.learn: Seed the rows with the project's own story (event, performer, theorist) and give each row one design extreme, ending with a free 'Variable' row

reconstruction.layout: Column x≈264–1176 (~912px); each row: control line (dropdown ~80px, slider ~400px from x≈440, number at right) then the sample; rows ~250–350px apart; first row starts ~75px under the cover
reconstruction.typography: Samples Movement caps: Direct Black (wght 900, SPAC 100), Direct Thin (wght 50, SPAC 100), Indirect Black (wght 900, SPAC 120), Indirect Thin (wght 50, SPAC 120) at 92, 240, 100, 50, 232px; controls ~11px nmtype
reconstruction.behaviour: font-viewer custom element (contenteditable=plaintext-only) driven by font-controls: radio list of presets sets font-variation-settings; 'Variable' preset (data-axis=show) reveals wght and SPAC range+number inputs; font-size range 24–140/240/340 px with responsive attribute
reconstruction.content: Real names and facts from the project: Body in motion, Design Indaba, The Performer Andile Vellem, Rudolf Laban, Dance!
reconstruction.html: figure.specimen-display-block#tab-viewerN > font-viewer[editable][contenteditable=plaintext-only][style=font-variation-settings;font-size] ; font-controls[target] > details.tooltip.specimen-controls-variants > label.toggle > input[type=radio][value="variation:'wght' 900,'SPAC' 100"] ; label.slider-label > input.slider[name=font-size|variation.wght|variation.SPAC] + input.slider-number

instances.look: A two-column text block (left: small metadata list Script, Release 2019, Type design, Performance, Film, Music, Specimen → Download PDF, Download Free fonts; right: four paragraphs on the dance collaboration and Laban's theory), then the 2:18 performance film with 'DESIGN INDABA' title card and two silent looping clips of the dancer on grey
